candidate_modular_formula.coefficient_group: A=Aut_tensor(Id_C), identified with invertible objects for modular C
candidate_modular_formula.covector_coordinate_rule: If the saved marking is lambda_i=<alpha,x_i>, first convert a=Q^(-1)lambda. For q(a)=zeta^(c a^2), the phase is zeta^(c lambda^T Q^(-1) lambda).
candidate_modular_formula.homology_coordinate_rule: For alpha=sum_i x_i tensor a_i and Q_ij=x_i.x_j, Phi_Q(alpha)=product_i q_C(a_i)^(Q_ii) product_{i<j} b_C(a_i,a_j)^(Q_ij).
candidate_modular_formula.normalization_safe_calibration: q_C(a)=Z_C(CP2,a)/Z_C(CP2,0) in a pinned orientation convention
candidate_modular_formula.ordinary_value_role: Under the modular CKY normalization, Z_C(M,0) is already controlled by Euler characteristic and signature. The candidate formula adds the complete alpha-dependent quadratic phase.
candidate_modular_formula.premodular_extension_status: CONJECTURAL_DIRECTION_NOT_ESTABLISHED. The same pessimistic conclusion may extend after separating transparent-sector and pi1 data, but neither the formula nor a premodular Figure 21 comparison is proved by this audit.
candidate_modular_formula.scope: closed connected oriented smooth simply connected 4-manifolds with torsion-free H2 and modular category input

established_computational_theorem.statement: For every one of the 201 hash-bound eligible H2-marked artifact rows enumerated by twisted-yetter-quadratic-block-prediction-audit-v1, the saved Twisted Yetter value agrees within the recorded tolerance with the absolute basic-block evaluation and/or the induced quadratic-refinement prediction. The denominator includes 18 genuine off-diagonal mutual-intersection witnesses, and 8 rows reject the incorrect direct-Q covector formula. There are zero certified counterexamples in this frozen denominator.

figure21_specialization.distribution_level_result: Across 15 pointed modular realizations of ranks 2 through 5, all 15 Figure 21 value distributions match CP2#9(-CP2) after presentation normalization independently calibrated from the ordinary Kirby-color aggregate. Thirteen rows already match raw; the two semion rows have raw graph sums -32 versus +32 and therefore use the derived correction -1.
figure21_specialization.why_distribution_is_weaker: A matching multiset does not identify which alpha on Figure 21 maps to which alpha in the standard diagonal basis.

simply_connected_standard_block_scope.direct_prediction_does_not_need_11_8: If the candidate quadratic formula is proved, the intersection form Q and alpha already determine the phase. A named connected-sum decomposition is convenient but not logically required.
simply_connected_standard_block_scope.even_case_conditional_on_11_8: After orientation write Q=-2kE8+nH. Rokhlin makes k integral. The 11/8 conjecture is exactly n>=3k; if true, Freedman's classification gives the unstabilized topological model #k K3 #(n-3k)(S2xS2).
simply_connected_standard_block_scope.existing_exotic_pair_does_not_need_11_8: For a specified homeomorphic exotic pair such as Figure 21 and its standard model, the shared topological type and intersection form are already known.
simply_connected_standard_block_scope.odd_case: Odd indefinite unimodular forms are diagonal, and Donaldson supplies the smooth definite restriction. Freedman's classification then gives the smoothable topological model as a connected sum of CP2 and -CP2 blocks.

title: Explicit quadratic-block prediction audit for modular Twisted Yetter data
top_notice: This note establishes an exact machine-checked statement about 201 frozen H2-marked rows. It does not prove the proposed formula for arbitrary modular tensor categories. Figure 21 now has 15 of 15 pointed distributions matching after an independently derived ordinary-aggregate presentation normalization, but remains distribution-level evidence only because no certified H2 marking exists. The finite-coefficient phase is described by a Pontryagin square or induced quadratic refinement, not by p1(TM).
